articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: CVS Health Faces Antitrust Scrutiny As Valuation Flags Undervaluation Risk. U.S. House Judiciary Committee alleges CVS Health restricted independent pharmacies from using competing digital pharmacy hubs. The investigation cites cease and desist letters and network rule changes as potential antitrust issues. CVS Health disputes the findings and says some policies have been revised.
